reason: Myntra MMIP Omni/PPMP API (Postman collection https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/34879541/2sA3JNbLQG, collection JSON re-read 2026-09-25): the token flow is now expressible (POST {{api-domain}}/authorization/generate_token, form merchant_id + secret_key header, access_token returned in a RESPONSE HEADER → session login with login.headers + token_from_header, then an access_token header and x-partner-store), but the calls the vocabulary needs are not documented precisely enough to map without guessing: (1) Update Inventory (PUT /partner/v4/inventory/update, "Maximum number of SKUs allowed in one call is 10") is documented as a Postman form-data body (inventoryCount, sku, processingSla, storeCode) while sending "Content-Type: application/json", and its partial-failure example echoes different names (quantity, store_code) — the wire encoding (form vs JSON object vs JSON array) is contradictory; (2) OrderSearch (GET /partner/v4/order/getOrderList?page&statusCode&startDate&endDate) documents only a 500 error example, no success shape; (3) Ready To Ship is keyed by Myntra's tracking number, not the order id; (4) the {{api-domain}} host is not published (issued at partner onboarding). Needs: a documented inventory request encoding and an OrderSearch success schema (docs gap, not a runtime gap).
